FHIR R4 `Observation` has **no `resultStatus` element**.

You likely mean **`Observation.status`**:

- **Cardinality:** `1..1` (required)
- **Value set:** [ObservationStatus](https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/valueset-observation-status.html)
- **Binding strength:** Required
- **Codes:** `registered`, `preliminary`, `final`, `amended`, `corrected`, `cancelled`, `entered-in-error`, `unknown`
